app.subtitle: Your iOS workspace
settings.title: Language and appearance
settings.subtitle: Changes apply immediately and are saved.
settings.logs: External tools keep their original output language.
storage.title: STORAGE LOCATION
storage.instructions: Choose the parent of VMs, or an empty folder for a new installation.
vm.subtitle: Manage your iPhone environments in one place.
vm.empty_help: Create a VM or select the folder containing your existing VMs.
vm.resources_help: CPU and RAM changes require a stopped VM.
vm.stop_warning: After 30 seconds, vphone-cli may force termination. Unsaved data may be lost.
ssh.title: SSH connection
ssh.help: SSH connects to the selected VM through USB/UDID. No IP address is required.
create.title: Set up a new iPhone
create.subtitle: Download source, prepare firmware and install CFW in one flow.
create.name: VM name
create.hardware_note: iPhone17,3 identifies the source firmware. Virtual hardware may report a different model.
create.iphone_source: iPhone IPSW HTTPS URL or file path
create.cloud_source: cloudOS IPSW HTTPS URL or file path
create.pair_note: Custom firmware compatibility depends on vphone-cli.
create.defaults: Starts with 8 CPUs / 8 GB RAM. Adjust after installation with the VM stopped. Firmware and temporary files need extra space.
create.preflight: Complete Preparation first. Administrator prompts and installation output appear in the app.
create.exists: This VM name exists. Choose another name or resume its CFW stage.
create.download_note: Downloads Apple firmware and Lakr233/vphone-cli. Existing VMs are not overwritten.
setup.title: Prepare your Mac
setup.subtitle: Check prerequisites before installing.
setup.amfi_note: Uses upstream amfidont for vphone-cli.app only. Enter the administrator password in the secure field when prompted.
setup.recovery_help: Shut down the Mac. Hold the power button → Options → Terminal. Run the commands there, then return to macOS.
setup.recovery_warning: Relaxes SIP debugging restrictions and uses app-scoped amfidont. System protection is reduced. These settings and NVRAM are not changed automatically.
setup.fairplay: Jailbreak does not decrypt FairPlay IPAs. VM SEP limitations may prevent Apple Account / iCloud sign-in and some apps from working.
check.sdk: Choose full Xcode; Command Line Tools alone are insufficient.
check.research_unknown: Cannot verify here. If the VM boots, permission is available; otherwise check Recovery setup.
check.cli_bad: Missing or blocked by macOS. Install dependencies or fix AMFI.
check.session: Uses your existing ipatool App Store session.
console.input_help: Reply to the prompt above. Passwords and codes are not saved; input is always hidden.
console.stop_warning: Firmware installation may remain incomplete. Files are kept; you may need to resume CFW or create another VM.
console.quit_help: Finish or stop the installation, download or SSH session before quitting.
ipa.prompt: Enter an app name to search.
ipa.drive_missing: Download drive is disconnected. Connect it or choose another folder.
ipa.subtitle: Search and download from the App Store
ipa.paid_help: Paid apps require an existing license. No purchase is made.
ipa.fairplay: Official IPAs may use FairPlay. Downloading does not guarantee they work in a virtual iPhone.
ipa.need_running: Select a running VM to install an IPA.
ipa.udid_error: VM UDID unavailable. No physical device was modified.
repair.title: Refresh JB icons
repair.help: If Sileo/TrollStore are missing, refresh app registration over SSH. No files are deleted.
repair.requires_jb: This VM uses regular/dev firmware. Sileo and TrollStore require a jb or exp VM.
update.available: Version {0} is available. Download the update.
ssh.proxy_missing: Install dependencies first: iproxy is required.
